ModMetaData.name: Serums Expended
ModMetaData.author: Kerem
ModMetaData.description: Adds refined and advanced upgrades for Anomaly combat and mental serums, a three-tier Marksman ranged-combat serum, plus Neuroplastic serums that turn skills into major passions, plus Regenesis treatments that repair permanent injuries or restore missing biological parts after a regenerative coma. One recipe per serum automatically uses an available lower-tier dose or its equivalent raw materials. Recipe details show cycling ingredient icons and a comparison of all production alternatives. Uses the vanilla serum lab. Requires RimWorld 1.6 or 1.7, Anomaly and Harmony. Compatible with Combat Extended.
